# Model: haiku

## CONVERSATION
Concierge: Hi Ron! I'm your Shiftsmart concierge. How can I help?
Partner: What's a floater shift? I see one available but I don't know what that means

## CONCIERGE OUTPUT
A floater shift means you're on standby — you show up at the store at the scheduled time. If they need extra help, you work the shift. If not, you're released after about 30-60 minutes and you get paid for showing up.
